description: Portable NIUBI Partition Editor Free Edition for Windows.

script: if (-not $match.Success) { throw 'Could not find the NIUBI Partition Editor version on the official download page.' }

notes: Free for home users and non-commercial use only; the Free Edition does not include Bootable Media Builder.
Partition-management operations can permanently affect data. Review pending operations carefully before applying them.
The vendor does not publish a SHA-256 checksum for this download, so the archive hash is not pinned in this manifest.
